steps: Open the new pause starter in real Studio, inspect exact TXT in Chinese/English/Japanese at 390px, cancel without writes, then explicitly create and ordinarily save the new script and registration. No target_scene_id export exists.

Manage the existing level behavior through Studio: preview/cancel leaves all bytes untouched; explicit Save adds exactly one reviewed script reference to the behavior registration without changing its source.

Add a fresh binding to the player and select the newly linked script. Explicit Add missing supplies exactly action_name, paused_text and resume_text. Three-language 390px views show all three defaults with no target parameter. Cancel discards the new binding and every local row without author writes.

Add a different fresh binding, explicitly Add missing, edit pause action and multilingual display text, inspect three-language narrow layouts, Check and Apply. Every existing binding byte range remains exact. Apply writes no author file; ordinary Save changes only the level behavior source.

Reload and reopen retain the explicit source, instance, three explicit parameters and fresh identity. The ordinary four-scene build snapshot is valid, the script remains exact, and the retained author-final workspace matches saved UI bytes. Official sample and all guarded production source hashes stay unchanged.

pause-script-zh-CN.title: 新建脚本
pause-script-zh-CN.description: 通过已映射的 action_name（默认 pause，建议映射 P）暂停与恢复；paused_text 和 resume_text 设置提示文字。失焦自动暂停，重聚焦不会自动恢复；恢复前须松开已注册玩法动作。暂停时停止玩法与游戏时钟，恢复不重置本次运行的有限预算。进入时按住、界面已处理的输入不触发；保留 Escape 结束。只创建普通脚本，不创建输入映射。

pause-script-en.title: New script
pause-script-en.description: Use a mapped action_name (pause by default; P is suggested) to pause and resume. paused_text and resume_text set the messages. Losing focus pauses automatically; regaining focus does not resume. Release registered gameplay actions before resuming. Gameplay and its clock stop while paused; resuming preserves this run’s finite budgets. Held entry input and UI-consumed presses do not trigger. Escape still ends the run. Creates an ordinary script, not an input map.

pause-script-ja.title: スクリプトを新規作成
pause-script-ja.description: 登録済みの action_name（既定は pause、Pへの割り当てを推奨）で一時停止・再開します。paused_text と resume_text で表示文を設定します。フォーカスを失うと自動停止し、戻しても自動再開しません。再開前に登録済みのゲーム操作を離してください。停止中はゲームと時計が止まり、再開しても実行中の有限予算はリセットしません。入場時の長押しやUIで処理済みの入力では切り替えません。Escape は実行終了用です。通常のスクリプトのみ作成し、入力設定は作成しません。

limitations: Actual Chrome and Studio HTTP editor on a disposable reference-game fixture. This is not from-blank project creation, installed Tauri or Android acceptance.
The pause TXT, registration, relation, binding and three parameter rows are absent at the recorded start; each is created through ordinary Studio controls. Original sample files remain untouched.

The fixture alone maps pause to P and Space, loops collection audio and adds an ordinary tick-counter TXT/binding for later independent native freeze observations. Browser evidence claims no native gameplay.
Exact-source parameter hints remain advisory. Explicit Add missing, local editing, Check, Apply and ordinary Save are distinct operations; Cancel never writes.
